dcterms:description: The University of Maryland Reddit Suicidality Dataset was developed using data from Reddit, specifically from the r/SuicideWatch subreddit, to identify suicidality risk of the post subject. It contains post id, anonymous user id, timestamp, subreddit name, post title, and post body, with labels indicating varying levels of suicidality risk.
dcterms:title: University of Maryland Reddit Suicidality Dataset
